announcements.title: # 账号安全公告：请及时修改密码并检查 API Key
announcements.content: # 账号安全公告：请及时修改密码并检查 API Key ## 一、关于此次异常登录尝试 2026年10月14日，本站发现同一异常来源对登录接口进行了大量自动化登录尝试。本次排查记录到 313,132 次失败登录。 通俗来说，就是通过脚本反复提交账号和密码，由系统逐次验证。账号来源为QQ交流群内QQ邮箱账号，也就是说这个人就在QQ群内，使用群内用户的QQ账号邮箱来暴力破解，这类行为可能是暴力猜测密码，也可能是“撞库”——使用从其他渠道获得的账密组合尝试登录，其它渠道邮箱账号未受到影响。 313,132 次是失败登录的累计数量，不代表尝试了这么多个不同密码，也不代表每个账号都被尝试了这么多次。 本站现已启用人机验证，并开放邮箱密码重置功能以及google 双因素认证（2FA）功能，可以在站内个人资料页面添加2FA二次认证。请大家使用独立密码，避免因简单密码或与其他网站共用密码而增加风险。 ## 二、以下用户请优先完成安全检查 以下43个账号存在与异常登录来源关联的成功登录记录，属于重点核查对象，为保护账号安全，43个账号均已修改为复杂独立密码且拥有余额账户的API密钥已经全部删除，登录时请通过邮箱重置密码。其它非QQ邮箱账号，也可设置复杂密码，避免不法分子通过撞库等手段暴力破解。 这不代表已确认全部账号被盗，更不代表这些用户是攻击者。 为保护隐私，名单仅显示脱敏邮箱： - `120023@qq.com` - `243552@qq.com` - `348966@qq.com` - `223739@qq.com` - `107733@qq.com` - `301027@qq.com` - `286*768@qq.com` - `173388@qq.com` - `134711@qq.com` - `141297@qq.com` - `616*814@qq.com` - `395831@qq.com` - `201397@qq.com` - `178327@qq.com` - `305*483@qq.com` - `145911@qq.com` - `253641@qq.com` - `739*853@qq.com` - `237850@qq.com` - `227538@qq.com` - `359*061@qq.com` - `242622@qq.com` - `110847@qq.com` - `192936@qq.com` - `112815@qq.com` - `315*227@qq.com` - `739*742@qq.com` - `381451@qq.com` - `610*472@qq.com` - `965*845@qq.com` - `171005@qq.com` - `139412@qq.com` - `297648@qq.com` - `246974@qq.com` - `270396@qq.com` - `383*114@qq.com` - `164784@qq.com` - `530*321@qq.com` - `292046@qq.com` - `117915@qq.com` - `338877@qq.com` - `826*716@qq.com` - `143220@qq.com` ## 三、如何修改密码 ### 能够正常登录 进入「个人资料」，填写原密码并设置新密码。 ### 忘记密码或无法登录 在登录页点击「忘记密码」，填写注册邮箱，通过收到的密码重置链接设置新密码。 建议使用至少 12位、包含大小写字母、数字和符号的独立密码，不要使用手机号、生日、简单数字组合，或其他网站已经使用过的密码。 未列入名单的用户，如果使用简单密码或共用密码，也建议及时更换。 ## 四、请同时检查 API Key 和使用记录 请检查自己的 API Key、使用记录和余额，重点留意： - 是否存在非本人创建的 API Key。 - 是否存在不认识的模型调用。 - 是否出现与自己使用情况不符的扣费。 修改登录密码不会自动更换现有 API Key。 如怀疑密钥已经泄露，请删除并重新创建，同时更新客户端中的配置，避免客户端继续使用已失效的旧密钥。 发现异常请及时联系管理员核查，不要在公告评论或公开聊天中发送完整密钥。 请仅通过本站官方域名 api-hub.asia 操作，不要向任何人提供密码、邮箱验证码或 API Key。 感谢大家的理解与配合。

announcements.title: Site notice
announcements.content: ### Welcome to Modelflare Modelflare’s first priority is stability. We help more users access global SOTA AI models reliably and at lower cost. Credits are denominated in US dollars: top up US$1 and US$1 is added to your credit balance. New users receive US$0.25 automatically after signup. If you run into request failures, slow responses, unavailable models, top-up issues, or billing questions, please contact us through support tickets, our after-sales QQ group, or Telegram.

🎉 DeepSeek and GLM price reductions Effective immediately, DeepSeek is now 60% of the official price (previously 80%), and GLM is now 68% of the official price (previously 80%). You're welcome to try them out!

🔥 Limited-time affiliate commission increase to 20% We have truly felt everyone’s enthusiasm for sharing Modelflare lately! To thank every affiliate partner for your support, the Modelflare Affiliate Program is now offering up to 20% commission for a limited time 🎉 During the promotion, eligible top-ups made by users referred through your dedicated affiliate link can earn commission. The end date will be announced separately. Please refer to the Affiliate Program page for full terms. 👉 Apply to become an affiliate partner: https://modelflare.dev/affiliate-program

🛡️ OpenAI Cache Hit Rate Guarantee Is Now Live OpenAI's official cache hit rate has remained unstable recently. To protect our users, Modelflare will cover the cost of the shortfall. Award, Stable, and Premium provide minimum daily cache hit rate guarantees of 65%, 75%, and 85%, respectively. The system reviews requests that meet OpenAI's caching requirements and form valid caches, calculated by UTC calendar day. If the daily cache hit rate falls below the applicable guarantee, we will compensate the difference. Once the compensation is credited, it can be viewed under Dashboard → Token Usage Analysis.

🛠️ Stability maintenance update: Grok Award promotion and temporary Luna change To reduce the impact of upstream quality fluctuations on your experience, the following changes take effect immediately: 1. `grok-award` is now available at a 0.005 multiplier We have recently seen frequent output-quality fluctuations on official Grok routes, and their stability does not currently meet our platform requirements. We are therefore offering `grok-award` at a 0.005 multiplier while capacity lasts. The promotion will continue until all current Grok supplier capacity is exhausted. `grok-award` will then be paused and restored after we find a stable official access solution with reliable output quality. 2. `gpt-5.6-luna` is temporarily retired and mapped to `gpt-5.6-terra` We have not found a Luna supplier that remains stable over time, and the previous routes also showed intermittent instability. To protect the platform's overall request success rate, Luna has been temporarily removed from public selection. During this period, all `gpt-5.6-luna` requests will be mapped to `gpt-5.6-terra` so existing calls can continue. Model behavior and output style may differ, so please take care with workloads that require highly consistent output. If you can provide a stable and reliable Luna route, please contact us. We would rather adjust proactively than leave an unstable route for users to encounter by chance. Thank you for your understanding and support.

🎉 DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental is now live Modelflare now supports `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` through the `deepseek-stable` group, with image-and-text understanding and OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses APIs. At the same time, `deepseek-stable` pricing has been reduced to 90% of official list prices. `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` uses the same base pricing as `deepseek-v4-flash`: - Input: US$0.44 / 1M tokens - Output: US$1.32 / 1M tokens - Cached input: US$0.014 / 1M tokens Set the model name to `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` to get started. This is an experimental model; test it with your workload before using it for critical applications.

🎨 GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana image APIs are now live Modelflare now supports two separate image-generation API contracts. GPT Image 2 / OpenAI-compatible Images API - Endpoint: `POST /v1/images/generations` - Model: `gpt-image-2` - `medium` / `high` quality - Short-lived signed URL or `b64_json` - Synchronous JSON or `stream=true` SSE - Current pricing is about 50% of the official API price; actual billing depends on quality and size The first GPT Image 2 release is text-to-image only, generates one image per request, and does not support `edits`, `variations`, or reference-image editing. Native Gemini image API - Nano Banana Pro: `gemini-3-pro-image` - Nano Banana 2: `gemini-3.1-flash-image` - Synchronous: `POST /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent` - Recommended for long requests: `POST /v1beta/models/{model}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse` - Nano Banana Pro estimated image prices: 1K / 2K `US$0.06720` per image; 4K `US$0.12000` per image - Nano Banana 2 estimated image prices: 0.5K `US$0.02241`, 1K `US$0.03360`, 2K `US$0.05040`, 4K `US$0.07560` per image - Prices are estimates per image; the final charge may vary slightly with request content Gemini image models use the native Gemini protocol and do not use `/v1/images/generations`. Send `/v1beta` requests through `modelflare.dev`. Image Workbench can now switch directly between GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro, and Nano Banana 2. Documentation and examples: https://modelflare.dev/docs/images

Modelflare `grok-4.6` is now officially available 🎉 It supports both the Chat Completions API and Responses API, with the same base pricing as `grok-4.5`: Input: US$2 per 1M tokens Output: US$6 per 1M tokens Cached input: US$0.5 per 1M tokens To get started, simply set the model name to `grok-4.6`. `grok-4.5` will remain available. Give it a try!

Modelflare has launched a limited-time Friend Referral Campaign 🎉 During the campaign, you can share your personal invite link. When a friend registers through your link and completes their first top-up, both you and your friend will receive Credits equal to 8% of the friend’s first top-up amount. Campaign page: https://modelflare.dev/invite-rewards For ongoing commissions and payouts, you can apply to become an Affiliate Partner: https://modelflare.dev/affiliate-program

Subscription plans are live: get up to 20% more API credits for the same budget ModelFlare 28-day subscription plans are now available across GPT, Claude, and Gemini model families. US$99.99 → US$110 total US$1,499.99 → US$1,800 total Credits are issued automatically in four installments, once every 7 days. Bigger plans unlock a higher bonus rate. View subscription plans: https://modelflare.dev/wallet?section=subscription

GPT-5.6 Luna Pricing Adjustment To continue providing GPT-5.6 Luna reliably, we reviewed the cost of operating the service. Because the current price no longer covers network bandwidth, infrastructure, and operating costs, we have chosen to keep the model available rather than remove it, and have adjusted its base price to 50% of the price before the latest reduction. New base prices: - Input: $0.50 / 1M tokens - Cached input: $0.05 / 1M tokens - Cache write: $0.625 / 1M tokens - Output: $3.00 / 1M tokens The new price took effect on August 6, 2026. Existing discounts for each user group remain unchanged. Thank you for your understanding and support.

Qwen3.8-Max is now available Qwen3.8-Max is now available on Modelflare through OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses API endpoints, plus an Anthropic Messages-compatible endpoint. Its 2.4T-parameter MoE architecture activates 95B parameters per token and supports a 1M-token context window, making it suitable for advanced coding, professional workflows, and long-horizon agent tasks. Access is currently limited to API keys eligible for the `qwen-stable` group. Model overview and setup guide: https://modelflare.dev/articles/qwen3-8-max-guide Live pricing and supported API formats: https://modelflare.dev/pricing/qwen3.8-max Please refer to these pages for current pricing and availability.

🎨 ModelFlare Image Workbench is live No API key setup is needed. Sign in, open Image Workbench from the left menu, and describe the image you want. Choose 1K/2K/4K, low/medium/high quality, and 1–4 images per run. Refine requests by chat; history is saved automatically. Usage-based billing applies. Reference cost is US$0.001–US$0.32 per image; agent text tokens are separate. This release is text-to-image only and does not edit previous images at the pixel level. Try it: https://modelflare.dev/image-workbench

🎉 The grok-award group is now available! Demand for Grok has been growing, so we’ve added the new grok-award group. Its multiplier is just 0.03, with pricing as low as 3% of official list prices. The group is now available for selection. Choose grok-award when creating or updating an API Key to get started.

Kimi K3 special-pricing availability update Kimi K3 special pricing is temporarily unavailable because of upstream compute constraints. Availability and stability are not guaranteed and may change without notice. Check the pricing page for the currently available groups before use. Do not use Kimi K3 for production or critical workloads.

ModelFlare Top-up Special is now available. Any single top-up reaching US$20 unlocks the openai-first-topup group. The current rate is 0.015x. Create or update an API key and select openai-first-topup to use it.

ModelFlare API Key Fallback Groups Are Now Available Configure ordered fallback groups under API Keys. Requests try channels in the primary group first, then switch through fallback groups. Billing follows the group that serves the request.

🎉 Claude Fable 5.1 is now live Modelflare now supports `claude-fable-5-1` with three routing options: - `claude-premium` (0.5x): $5 input / $25 output per 1M tokens — stability first - `claude-award` (0.25x): $2.50 input / $12.50 output per 1M tokens — lowest cost - `claude-stable` (0.315x): $3.15 input / $15.75 output per 1M tokens — recommended for daily development and production Try it now. Actual billing follows the pricing page.

🎉 Gemini 3.8 Flash is now live Modelflare now supports `gemini-3.8-flash` on `gemini-stable` (0.15x), with a 1M context window, at the same price as `gemini-3.7-flash`: - Input: $0.225 / 1M tokens - Output: $1.125 / 1M tokens - Cache read: $0.0225 / 1M tokens - Cache write: $0.15 / 1M tokens Supports Gemini-native `generateContent` and OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions. Actual billing follows the pricing page.

⚠️ Major upstream outage: all OpenAI, Claude, and Grok APIs are currently unavailable Due to a widespread outage in the North American server clusters of OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), and xAI (Grok), all model APIs from these three providers are currently unavailable. This is an upstream provider outage, not a Modelflare platform failure. We are monitoring recovery and will update this notice as soon as service is restored. Please pause requests to OpenAI, Claude, and Grok models for now. We apologize for the inconvenience.

✅ Upstream recovered: OpenAI, Claude, and Grok APIs are available again The widespread outage in the North American server clusters of OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), and xAI (Grok) has been resolved. All model APIs from these three providers are available again. If you still see isolated request failures, please retry shortly. Thank you for your patience.

🎉 GLM 5.3 Flash is now live, with lower GLM and Kimi group prices Modelflare now supports `glm-5.3-flash` on `glm-stable`, with a 1M context window. It works with OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages. After further optimization, we have also cut GLM and Kimi group prices: 1. `kimi-stable` is now 0.65x 2. `glm-stable` is now 0.5x For `glm-5.3-flash`, current effective pricing is: - Input: $0.075 / 1M tokens - Output: $0.25 / 1M tokens - Cache read: $0.015 / 1M tokens You're welcome to start using it. Actual billing follows the pricing page.

🎉 GPT-6 Astra is now live — try the world's strongest model OpenAI's latest flagship `gpt-6-astra` is now available on Modelflare. This is currently the world's most powerful model. You're welcome to try it. Official price per million tokens: input $10, output $50, cache read $1.

Please test latency for your region and choose the more stable route: - Main route: `https://modelflare.dev/v1` — recommended for everyday use, with support for longer non-streaming requests - Cloudflare Global Acceleration: `https://cf.modelflare.dev/v1` — optimized for most regions - Origin (EdgeOne): `https://origin.modelflare.dev/v1` — accelerated for Asia and mainland China, and can be used without a VPN You can test latency on the console home page and pick the faster, more stable endpoint. 🎉 Network upgrade complete — three API endpoints are now available We have completed a network upgrade. Users in different countries and regions can now choose the more stable API endpoint: - Main route: `https://modelflare.dev/v1` — recommended for everyday use, with support for longer non-streaming requests - Cloudflare Global Acceleration: `https://cf.modelflare.dev/v1` — optimized for most regions - Origin (EdgeOne): `https://origin.modelflare.dev/v1` — accelerated for Asia and mainland China, and can be used without a VPN Test latency on the console home page and choose the faster, more stable route for you.

🎉 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now live — try the strongest domestic Flash Modelflare now supports `deepseek-v4.1-flash-0910` on `deepseek-stable` (0.6x). DeepSeek says it beats V4 Pro on quality, cost, and speed, with million-token context, up to 384K output, and native vision. It works with OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses. Current effective pricing: - Input: $0.1935 / 1M tokens - Output: $0.7742 / 1M tokens - Cache read: $0.00387 / 1M tokens You're welcome to start using it. Actual billing follows the pricing page.

🔒 For your data security, usage logs are now cleared automatically Modelflare never stores your prompts or model responses; logs hold only a per-call summary (model, tokens, cost, time, IP). That data is now cleared on a schedule. Default retention is 365 days; shorten it to 7, 30, 60 or 180 days under Profile → Log Retention. Cleanup runs daily at 04:00 UTC+8 and is final. Cleared: usage and error records past your period. Kept: monthly summaries, payment records, dashboard stats.

🎉 Image and video generation is live — 41 models now available We have added a new set of image and video models. On video, the lineup currently covers Wan, Seedance, MiniMax, Kling, and HappyHorse. On image, it covers Seedream, GPT Image, Gemini Image, and Wan Image — 41 models in total. See the full list and live prices on [Models & Pricing](/pricing), and the calling guides in [Docs](/docs). Create an API key and select the dedicated Media group (`media`) before you start. There's also a little surprise in the model list 🤫

announcements.content: ### Welcome to Modelflare Modelflare’s first priority is stability. We help more users access global SOTA AI models reliably and at lower cost. Credits are denominated in US dollars: top up US$1 and US$1 is added to your credit balance. New users receive US$0.25 automatically after signup. We have completed a network upgrade and now offer three API endpoints. Please test latency for your region and choose the more stable route: - Main route: `https://modelflare.dev/v1` — recommended for everyday use, with support for longer non-streaming requests - Cloudflare Global Acceleration: `https://cf.modelflare.dev/v1` — optimized for most regions - Origin (EdgeOne): `https://origin.modelflare.dev/v1` — accelerated for Asia and mainland China, and can be used without a VPN You can test latency on the console home page and pick the faster, more stable endpoint. If you run into request failures, slow responses, unavailable models, top-up issues, or billing questions, please contact us through support tickets or email support@modelflare.dev.

🎉 Claude top-up group is live — any single top-up of US$50+ unlocks 0.03x pricing OpenAI's official capacity has been tight lately and its routes keep running into problems. If your workload allows, we encourage you to use Claude more: the new `claude-first-topup` group is live, and from now on any single top-up of US$50 or more permanently unlocks Claude models at 0.03x (about 3% of the official price), covering claude-opus-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-5, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-fable-5 and claude-fable-5-1. To use it, create or edit an API key under "API Keys" and pick the `claude-first-topup` group; smart keys include it automatically. The GPT top-up group (US$20+ for 0.015x) is unchanged, and a US$50+ top-up unlocks both. Live prices are on [Models & Pricing](/pricing); top up from your [Wallet](/billing).

🎉 Castaly is live — image and video generation gets a studio of its own Our image and video site, Castaly, is now live at [castaly.modelflare.dev](https://castaly.modelflare.dev/). Sign in with the Modelflare account you already have and start right away; there is no separate registration. Create in the browser. Pick a model, write the prompt, adjust the parameters and review the result in one workspace. Everything you generate stays in your library, ready to revisit, download or delete. Or call it locally. If you would rather work in a terminal, head to Castaly's [Skill page](https://castaly.modelflare.dev/skill/): it gives you the install for the agent and operating system you actually use, and hands you the API key the calls need. Once it is in place, Claude Code, Codex and other Skill-aware tools can generate for you directly. Your balance is shared. Castaly spends the same paid balance as the main site, so there is no second top-up, and usage and billing stay in one place (gift credit is still counted per product). The platform carries 39 image and video models today: Seedream, GPT Image, Gemini Image and Wan Image on the image side, and Wan, Seedance, Kling, MiniMax and HappyHorse on the video side, 12 of them NSFW editions. Each model's request contract, parameter table and examples live on the docs site at [docs.modelflare.dev](https://docs.modelflare.dev), and live prices are on [Models & Pricing](/pricing).

🎉 Seedance 2.0 Fast and Mini are live — two cheaper Seedance 2.0 SKUs ByteDance Seedance 2.0 now includes `seedance-2.0-fast` and `seedance-2.0-mini`. They use the same `POST /v1/videos` endpoint, at 480p / 720p and 4–15 seconds (or `-1` to let the model pick the length). Text, image, video/audio references, and synced audio are supported. Billing is token-based: Fast is 65% of the official list price, Mini is 52%. Jobs with video input use a lower unit price. Live quotes: [seedance-2.0-fast](/pricing/seedance-2.0-fast) and [seedance-2.0-mini](/pricing/seedance-2.0-mini). Use the Media group `media` on your API key, or generate in the [Castaly workbench](https://castaly.modelflare.dev/workbench/). Guides: [seedance-2.0-fast](https://docs.modelflare.dev/models/video/seedance-2-0-fast/) and [seedance-2.0-mini](https://docs.modelflare.dev/models/video/seedance-2-0-mini/). For 1080p / 4K or longer clips, keep using `seedance-2.0` or `seedance-2.5`.

🎉 Grok 4.7 is live — Extra High beats same-tier Opus 5 on CursorBench xAI's new flagship `grok-4.7` is now available on Modelflare. It has a 500K context window, accepts text and image input, and returns text. Chat Completions and the Responses API are both supported. `grok-4.5` and `grok-4.6` stay available. On [CursorBench](https://cursor.com/cn/evals), Grok 4.7 Extra High scores 46.3%, ahead of Opus 5 Extra High at 46.1%. Cursor's published-price cost is about $6.01 per task, compared with $11.43 for Opus 5 Extra High. Opus 5 Max scores 46.6%. Cursor notes that scores vary, and small gaps may not be statistically meaningful. To match this effort level, set `reasoning_effort` to `xhigh` (the default is `high`). Both groups are open. The list price matches `grok-4.6`, then the group multiplier applies: - `grok-award` (0.03x): input $0.06, output $0.18, cache read $0.015 per 1M tokens - `grok-stable` (0.11x): input $0.22, output $0.66, cache read $0.055 per 1M tokens Pick the group on your API key and set the model to `grok-4.7`. Live prices: [grok-4.7](/pricing/grok-4.7). Billing follows the pricing page.

🎉 Muse Spark 1.3 and Jev 1.13 are live — one chat model, and one API that only answers closed questions Meta's `muse-spark-1.3` is open on the `spark-premium` group and uses Chat Completions. The official token price is input $1.25, output $4.25, and cache read $0.15 per 1M tokens. The group multiplier is 1.15, so this group is input $1.4375, output $4.8875, and cache read $0.1725. Select `spark-premium` on the API key and set the model to `muse-spark-1.3`. Live prices: [muse-spark-1.3](/pricing/muse-spark-1.3). TypeSafe's `jev-1.13` is open on the `jev-premium` group. It does not write free text, so do not send it to the chat API. The body is a `state` plus closed questions of type `noul`, `choice`, or `score`. Each question comes back as a probability. Call `POST /v1/decisions` with the model `jev-1.13`. The official price is input $0.042 per 1M tokens and output $0. At the same 1.15 multiplier, this group is input $0.0483 and output $0. Live prices: [jev-1.13](/pricing/jev-1.13). Billing follows the pricing page. The blog has an analysis and breakdown of Jev, starting at [JEV - A joint does not need a brain](/articles/jev-system-one-joints). There are ten pieces.

🎉 GPT-6 Sol is live — Claude Opus 5.5 is expected tonight OpenAI's `gpt-6-sol` is now available on Modelflare for complex coding and agentic work. The context window is 1.05M tokens, with up to 922K input tokens and 128K output tokens. It accepts text and image input and returns text. Chat Completions, the Responses API, and Compact responses are supported. `reasoning.effort` defaults to `medium`, and can also be `none`, `low`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max`. Built-in tools such as web search and code execution use the Responses API. Function calling on Chat Completions is available only when `reasoning_effort` is `none`. `claude-opus-5-5` is expected tonight. It is the first model in the Claude 5.5 family, built for long-running coding and knowledge work. Anthropic says it reaches Claude Fable 5.1 on most tasks, costs about 40% less than Opus 5 on typical workloads at default settings, and generates output more than 30% faster. The context window is 1M tokens, with up to 128K output tokens. Adaptive thinking stays on, and the default effort is `medium`. On Anthropic's published [CursorBench](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-opus-5-5) result, the default effort scores 52.5%, ahead of Fable 5.1 at max effort (51.8%) and Opus 5 at max effort (46.6%). Once it is live, use your existing Claude group. The Messages API and Chat Completions are both supported. Pick an OpenAI or Claude group on your API key and set the model to `gpt-6-sol` or `claude-opus-5-5`. Live prices: [Models & Pricing](/pricing). Billing follows the pricing page.

🎉 Claude Sonnet 5.5 is live — faster everyday coding, same list price as Sonnet 5 Anthropic released `claude-sonnet-5-5` on 28 September 2026. It is the second model in the Claude 5.5 family, aimed at well-scoped everyday work: fixing bugs, writing code, and producing documents, slides, and spreadsheets. It is also stronger at finishing a polished interface. For complex, open-ended work that needs sustained judgment, keep using `claude-opus-5-5`. `claude-sonnet-5` stays available. The context window is 1M tokens, with up to 128K output tokens. It accepts text and image input and returns text. The Messages API and Chat Completions are both supported. On the API, effort defaults to `high`, and can also be `low`, `medium`, `xhigh`, or `max`. The list price matches `claude-sonnet-5`. Anthropic says it usually spends fewer tokens on the same work, so most tasks cost up to 30% less, and it generates output more than 30% faster. On Terminal-Bench 4.0 it scores 70.6%, against 10.3% for Sonnet 5 and above Opus 5.5's published 66.4% at xhigh. On CursorBench 4.0 it scores 55.5%, second only to Opus 5.5. Details: [launch page](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-sonnet-5-5). `claude-award` and `claude-stable` are open now. The other groups will follow.

🎉 GPT-6.1 Sol is live — near Astra, cached input at half of Sol OpenAI released `gpt-6.1-sol` on 29 September 2026. It is an upgrade to `gpt-6-sol` for complex coding, computer use, and professional work. OpenAI says it comes close to `gpt-6-astra` on those tasks, at one-fifth of Astra's standard input and output prices. For the hardest scientific research, keep using `gpt-6-astra`. `gpt-6-sol` stays available. The context window is 1.05M tokens, with up to 922K input tokens and 128K output tokens. It accepts text and image input and returns text. Chat Completions, the Responses API, and Compact responses are supported. Use the Responses API for tool calling. `reasoning.effort` defaults to `medium`, and can also be `low`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max`. `none` and `minimal` are not supported. Official input and output prices match `gpt-6-sol`. Cached input is half of Sol's. On DeepSWE v1.1 it matches Astra and beats Sol's best score by 6.4 points. On AutomationBench at medium effort it scores 2.2 points above Opus 5.5 and 4.8 points above Sol. On the OSWorld 2.0 offline set at max effort it scores 7 points above Sol and comes within 2.1 points of Astra. Details: [launch page](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-1-sol/). Modelflare prices: [pricing page](/pricing/gpt-6.1-sol).

【公告】新增异常缓存补偿机制 为了进一步提升服务稳定性和用户体验，我们上线了异常缓存补偿机制。 补偿规则： 当系统检测到连续创建异常缓存时，将对该部分异常缓存产生的费用只收取原费用 20% 的扣费。 当前生效范围： 目前仅在 Claude 渠道 开启 Beta 测试。 后续计划： 该机制将逐步覆盖 PackyAPI 全部渠道。 此机制主要用于减少高峰期因异常缓存导致的不必要扣费情况，保护用户利益。 感谢各位用户一直以来的支持与反馈。如在使用过程中遇到任何问题，欢迎随时联系我们。 PackyAPI 团队 2026 年 5 月

【重要公告】Claude价格与服务调整通知 近期受 A 社封控策略和额度降低造成的成本影响，服务可用性有所下降。为保障使用的稳定与连续性，我们将于 2026年 4 月 1 日12:00起，暂时将 CC 分组倍率由 1.5 上调至 2.5。 我们将持续关注封控政策变化——若 A 社进一步加强风控，倍率可能再次涨幅；若情况缓解，我们也将第一时间恢复至 1.5 倍率，以回馈各位长期支持的用户。作为建议，当前可以选择使用 codex 或者 cc-sale 分组。其他分组不受此影响。 同时我们的退款始终保持开放，售后退款邮箱：support@packyme.com。 Packy 始终以“高可用与稳定服务”为首要目标。对于此次临时调整可能带来的不便，我们深表歉意，并感谢各位的理解与支持！ Packy Team 2026 年 3月 30 日

announcements.content: 🆕 GPT-6 Astra 已上线，GPT-5.4 同步下架 一、GPT-6 Astra 上线 OpenAI 最新旗舰 GPT-6 Astra 现已接入，模型名 gpt-6-astra 💰 价格（每百万 token） • 输入 $10，是 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 2 倍 • 缓存读 $1，是 Sol 的 2 倍 • 输出 $50，是 Sol 的约 1.7 倍 📏 上下文 1M，最大输出 128K，推理强度支持 low / medium / high / xhigh / max 🎯 适合谁用 Astra 在 Codex 长会话、电脑操作、长文档检索上提升明显，agent 编码任务的 token 用量约为 Sol 的三分之一，按任务算成本和 Sol 基本持平。幻觉率从 Sol 的 92% 降到 51%。 普通对话、短请求没有这个省 token 效应，按 token 结算就是 Sol 的 2 倍左右，日常轻量任务建议继续用 Sol 或 Terra。 二、GPT-5.4 下架 gpt-5.4 系列模型已下架，继续调用会返回模型不存在，请尽快切换： • 需要更强能力的直接上 gpt-5.6-sol 或 gpt-6-astra
